consequence.statement: Composite resources no longer have native connection details support; operators relying on it must recreate the feature by composing their own connection details Secret.
consequence.remediation: Compose your own connection details Secret as described in the connection details composition guide.

original.statement: Native connection details support for composite resources (XRs) is removed; managed resources keep writeConnectionSecretToRef, and XR users must compose their own connection details Secret.

decision.reason: [ev-e2dcb3e0ebe6] says native connection details support is removed from composite resources (XRs) and that the feature has to be recreated by composing your own connection details Secret. So an operator who relies on it has to do work, and the action class is supported. The evidence does not say exactly how it fails: an XR's connection-secret settings could be ignored or rejected. Because of that, migration-required (rebuild the feature through composition) is the closest kind the evidence supports, and choosing setting-ignored or resource-rejected would be a guess.
